subject.title: fix(telegram): keep Markdown parsing responsive on malformed links

question: Should Crabline intentionally impose a 1 MiB Telegram Markdown source limit before entity parsing when Telegram’s public semantic text limits are post-parse?
rationale: This is a provider-contract and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness fix: the repository policy requires protocol fidelity, while the PR supplies no authoritative provider limit for this new rejection path.

options.title: Keep only linear parsing
options.body: Use the forward-only scanner to prevent excessive work, but preserve existing acceptance behavior by removing the new source-size ceiling.

options.title: Approve a documented source cap
options.body: Keep the ceiling only after maintainers verify it against Telegram behavior and accept the resulting compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Keep only linear parsing
recommendation.body: Use the forward-only scanner to prevent excessive work, but preserve existing acceptance behavior by removing the new source-size ceiling.
